objects.description: One rater's value for one item. A repeat by the same rater on the same item replaces it, so the table is a matrix and not a log.

fields.name: rater
fields.description: The key of whoever rated, in the standard's module/instance/identity form, owned elsewhere and never resolved here.

fields.name: item
fields.description: The key of what was rated, in the same form and owned elsewhere too.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The rating on the module's one scale, 0 to 1, normalised by the host from whatever scale it shows.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When this value was written, replaced along with the value on a repeat.

indexes.name: item
indexes.description: Finds every rater of one item, which is the only set a write has to revisit.

objects.description: How alike two keys are by the declared metric over what they both rated. At most K rows per key and kind, so the table is bounded by K and not by the catalog.

fields.name: a
fields.description: The key whose neighbour this row records.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Whether the two keys are raters alike in taste or items alike in who rated them.

fields.name: metric
fields.description: Which of the module's closed set of measures produced the score.

fields.name: score
fields.description: The similarity, above 0 and at most 1 for every metric.

fields.name: overlap
fields.description: How many items both rated when the score was computed, so a reader can weigh a score by its evidence.

fields.name: at
fields.description: When the score was last computed.

indexes.name: rank
indexes.description: The K neighbours of one key in score order, which is what recommend reads and what the top-K maintenance compares against.

objects.description: One per-instance knob the module reads: the metric, which similarities run, K and the overlap floor. Rows because a declaration cannot carry them and a knob should survive a restart.

fields.name: key
fields.description: Which knob this is, from the module's fixed set of names.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The knob's value as text, parsed by the module against the blueprint's own vocabulary.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: When the knob was last written.
